title: When I was young: key phrases
subject: Italian

cards.answer: As a child I lived in the countryside.
cards.notes: The imperfect describes how things used to be.

cards.answer: Every summer we went to the seaside.
My grandfather was always telling stories.

cards.prompt: Avevo un cane che si chiamava Fido.
cards.answer: I had a dog called Fido.

cards.prompt: Giocavamo in strada fino a sera.
cards.answer: We played in the street until evening.

cards.prompt: La casa era piccola ma accogliente.
cards.answer: The house was small but cosy.
In winter it was very cold.
While I was cooking, I listened to the radio.

cards.prompt: Da piccola volevo fare la veterinaria.
cards.answer: When I was little I wanted to be a vet.

cards.prompt: Mia madre lavorava in un negozio.
cards.answer: My mother worked in a shop.

cards.prompt: Mentre dormivo, è suonato il telefono.
cards.answer: While I was sleeping, the phone rang.
cards.notes: Imperfect for the background, passato prossimo for what happened.
